svg.aria-label: the machine that is playing, stage by stage
svg.style: background: rgb(5, 7, 10); font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; display: block;

g.text: the parts the style declares, and the
the five streams every note lands on
the moves a theme makes on itself: the duck, the
one serial path the whole set passes

g.title: Every strip back to unity, nothing muted, soloed or dry, every device at its row, every stage block and the master at the room
Mute kick: kick. A shared instrument follows this everywhere.
Solo kick: kick. Solos add up; a mute wins.
kick: level kick 100 %. Press for the fader, sends and tools.
Mute offbeat: hatClosed, hatOpen. A shared instrument follows this everywhere.
Solo offbeat: hatClosed, hatOpen. Solos add up; a mute wins.
offbeat: level hatClosed 100 %, hatOpen 100 %. Press for the fader, sends and tools.
Mute offbeatOpen: hatClosed, hatOpen. A shared instrument follows this everywhere.
Solo offbeatOpen: hatClosed, hatOpen. Solos add up; a mute wins.
offbeatOpen: level hatClosed 100 %, hatOpen 100 %. Press for the fader, sends and tools.
Mute sixteenth: no instrument. A shared instrument follows this everywhere.
Solo sixteenth: no instrument. Solos add up; a mute wins.
sixteenth: level —. Press for the fader, sends and tools.
Mute backbeat: no instrument. A shared instrument follows this everywhere.
Solo backbeat: no instrument. Solos add up; a mute wins.
backbeat: level —. Press for the fader, sends and tools.
Mute top: no instrument. A shared instrument follows this everywhere.
Solo top: no instrument. Solos add up; a mute wins.
top: level —. Press for the fader, sends and tools.
Mute bassline: sub. A shared instrument follows this everywhere.
Solo bassline: sub. Solos add up; a mute wins.
bassline: level sub 100 %. Press for the fader, sends and tools.
Mute figure: triLead. A shared instrument follows this everywhere.
Solo figure: triLead. Solos add up; a mute wins.
figure: level triLead 100 %. Press for the fader, sends and tools.
Mute drone: supersawPad. A shared instrument follows this everywhere.
Solo drone: supersawPad. Solos add up; a mute wins.
drone: level supersawPad 100 %. Press for the fader, sends and tools.
Mute glueImpact: impact. A shared instrument follows this everywhere.
Solo glueImpact: impact. Solos add up; a mute wins.
glueImpact: level impact 100 %. Press for the fader, sends and tools.
Mute glueSwell: impact. A shared instrument follows this everywhere.
Solo glueSwell: impact. Solos add up; a mute wins.
glueSwell: level impact 100 %. Press for the fader, sends and tools.
Mute glueSweep: impact. A shared instrument follows this everywhere.
Solo glueSweep: impact. Solos add up; a mute wins.
glueSweep: level impact 100 %. Press for the fader, sends and tools.
Mute glueRiser: impact. A shared instrument follows this everywhere.
Solo glueRiser: impact. Solos add up; a mute wins.

Mute air: airTop, airRise. A shared instrument follows this everywhere.
Solo air: airTop, airRise. Solos add up; a mute wins.

g.text: 4.2 s, built on the first piano…

g.title: kick: kick. Press for its mute, solo and sends.
sub: sub. Press for its mute, solo and sends.
drums: hatClosed, hatOpen. Press for its mute, solo and sends.
melodic: airTop, airRise. Press for its mute, solo and sends.
keys: nothing on it this theme. Press for its mute, solo and sends.

g.text: a hot saturation of the low…
kick and bass as one instru…
a driven copy of the notes …
